prompts.title: Introduce your channel
prompts.script: Introduce yourself and your channel to a brand-new viewer.
tips: Say who you are and what the channel is about in your first sentence.
Finish by telling them why they should subscribe.

prompts.title: Explain one concept
prompts.script: Pick one concept from your niche and explain it.
tips: Explain it as if the viewer has never heard of it.
Use one concrete example instead of several vague ones.

prompts.title: A recent mistake
prompts.script: Share a short story about a mistake you made recently within your niche.
tips: Tell it in order: what happened, what went wrong, what you learned.
End on the lesson, not on "so yeah".

prompts.title: Unpopular opinion
prompts.script: State a view in your niche that many people disagree with, then argue for it.
tips: Open with the opinion itself, stated plainly.
Give two or three reasons, each in its own sentence.

prompts.title: Recommend a product
prompts.script: Recommend a product you offer, or want to offer, to your audience.
tips: Lead with the problem it solves for the viewer.
Close with a clear call to action.
